correctness.rationale: The stable-set polytope is exactly x>=0 with sum of block maxima <=1. Block maxima plus slack have Dirichlet(1,m1,...,mr) law; conditional block maxima yield one uniformly chosen maximum and independent uniform remaining coordinates. Multiplying exact conditional powers and Dirichlet moments proves the arbitrary multiindex formula, not merely sampled moments. Derived all covariances and Schur-convex inertia through strict positive second derivative g_N and splitting. Independent exact fraction checks on six block profiles confirm low-degree means/covariances and inertia, including r=1 cube boundary.
